title: The session settings that change results
description: `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` (true by default since 4.0) switches overflow, division by zero, casts, indexes and string coercion between raising and NULL or wrapping, and changes type coercion (`FLOAT + INT`, `'1' + 1`); it also sets `size(NULL)` (`spark.sql.legacy.sizeOfNull`) and the text of decimals cast to strings. `spark.sql.timestampType` decides what `TIMESTAMP` means, `spark.sql.session.timeZone` how `TIMESTAMP_LTZ` reads and prints. `spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate` turns the NULLs of degenerate `var_samp`, `covar_samp`, `corr` into NaN. `spark.sql.decimalOperations.allowPrecisionLoss` decides the result scale past 38 digits. `spark.sql.timeType.enabled` enables `TIME`. `spark.sql.shuffle.partitions` and the cluster's parallelism change the order of double sums, `first`, `collect_list` and ties (spark-exec-parallel). Outside Spark's configuration, the JVM's default locale changes `upper` and `lower` (spark-case).

sverify's Spark session sets ANSI on, UTC, `TIMESTAMP_NTZ`, case-sensitive names and unescaped string literals (`sverify.sql.spark.SPARK_CONF`); the probes ran with those, and each fact records the settings it was checked under.
reference: The reference has no settings. A profile's facts hold under the settings they record (`sverify._engine_settings`, #444); the Spark row needs ANSI on and the settings of `SPARK_CONF`.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark` runs each query four times on one local session: with `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` true and false, on the folded path (the optimizer evaluates a query over `VALUES` on the driver) and on the codegen path (`ConvertToLocalRelation` and `ConstantFolding` excluded, so the query runs as a job with whole-stage code generation). probes.json keeps one result per ANSI setting where the two paths agree. Spark 4.3.0 (pyspark 4.3.0), Java 21.0.12, Linux x86_64, `local[2]`, session time zone UTC, `spark.sql.timestampType=TIMESTAMP_NTZ`.
